experienceSection.title: Experience
experienceSection.subtitle: Robotics, XR and AI engineering — plus full-stack web.

points: Developing an e-commerce platform: a store-management back office and a customer-facing WeChat Mini Program.
Built a full-stack VR teleoperation platform for robots, including interactive UI, mixed reality, computer-vision integration and external UVC camera support.
Developed Android native plugins for Meta Quest that run ONNX models on-device, including sherpa-onnx text-to-speech.
Designed and integrated robot data-collection hardware: a Meta Quest–based UMI device and an egocentric sensing platform.
Built end-to-end data pipelines on Raspberry Pi and Meta Quest with synchronized video, sensor and IoT recording for robot learning.
Developed real-time multi-modal media streaming between robots, XR devices and remote operator stations.
Deployed a voice-interactive AI agent on ESP32 (ESP-Claw) and Raspberry Pi (zero-Claw) for natural-language conversation and robot control.
Provided engineering support for text-to-image and text-to-video experiments.
Fine-tuned Stable Diffusion on limited hardware using LoRA and model parallelism.
Deployed a text-to-video pipeline focused on multi-character generation and character consistency.
Supported coursework through grading and office hours; gave a well-received guest lecture on diffusion models.
Deployed lab servers to speed up research projects.
Designed, implemented and ran experiments across research initiatives so project leads could focus on ideas.
